arxiv-2011-14421.title: WIP: Short-Term Flow-Based Bandwidth Forecasting using Machine Learning
arxiv-2011-14421.creator: Maxime Labonne, Jorge López, Claude Poletti, Jean-Baptiste Munier
arxiv-2011-14421.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel framework to predict traffic flows’ bandwidth ahead of time. Modern network management systems share a common issue: the network situation evolves between the moment the decision is made and the moment when actions (countermeasures) are applied. This framework converts packets from real-life traffic into flows containing relevant features.

arxiv-2201-13339.title: The L ∞ L^{\infty} estimates for parabolic complex Monge-Ampere and Hessian equations
arxiv-2201-13339.creator: Xiuxiong Chen, Jingrui Cheng
arxiv-2201-13339.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider a version of parabolic complex Monge-Ampere equations, and use a PDE approach similar to Phong et al to establish L ∞ L^{\infty} and Hölder estimates. We also generalize the L ∞ L^{\infty} estimates to parabolic Hessian equations. Dedicated to Prof. Lawson for his 80th birthday 1.

arxiv-2310-06675.title: SEER: A Knapsack approach to Exemplar Selection for In-Context HybridQA
arxiv-2310-06675.creator: Jonathan Tonglet, Manon Reusens, Philipp Borchert, Bart Baesens
arxiv-2310-06675.description: Abstract Question answering over hybrid contexts is a complex task, which requires the combination of information extracted from unstructured texts and structured tables in various ways. Recently, In-Context Learning demonstrated significant performance advances for reasoning tasks. In this paradigm, a large language model performs predictions based on a small set of supporting exemplars.

arxiv-2406-05764.title: Global Sensitivity Analysis of Uncertain Parameters in Bayesian Networks
arxiv-2406-05764.creator: Rafael Ballester-Ripoll, Manuele Leonelli
arxiv-2406-05764.description: Abstract Traditionally, the sensitivity analysis of a Bayesian network studies the impact of individually modifying the entries of its conditional probability tables in a one-at-a-time (OAT) fashion. However, this approach fails to give a comprehensive account of each inputs’ relevance, since simultaneous perturbations in two or more parameters often entail higher-order effects that cannot be captured by an OAT analysis.

arxiv-2410-19940.title: Cobblestone: A Divide-and-Conquer Approach for Automating Formal Verification
arxiv-2410-19940.creator: Saketh Ram Kasibatla, Arpan Agarwal, Yuriy Brun, Sorin Lerner, Talia Ringer, Emily First
arxiv-2410-19940.description: Abstract . Formal verification using proof assistants, such as Coq, is an effective way of improving software quality, but requires significant effort and expertise. Machine learning can automatically synthesize proofs, but such tools are able to prove only a fraction of desired software properties. We introduce Cobblestone , a divide-and-conquer approach for proof synthesis.

arxiv-2410-20957.title: Neuro-symbolic Learning Yielding Logical Constraints
arxiv-2410-20957.creator: Zenan Li, Yunpeng Huang, Zhaoyu Li, Yuan Yao, Jingwei Xu, Taolue Chen, Xiaoxing Ma, Jian Lü
arxiv-2410-20957.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zenan Li, Yunpeng Huang, Zhaoyu Li, Yuan Yao, Jingwei Xu, Taolue Chen, Xiaoxing Ma, Jian Lü. Neuro-symbolic systems combine neural perception and logical reasoning, representing one of the priorities of AI research. End-to-end learning of neuro-symbolic systems is highly desirable, but remains to be challenging.

arxiv-2412-13139.title: A Physical Interpretation of Imaginary Time Delay
arxiv-2412-13139.creator: Isabella L. Giovannelli, Steven M. Anlage
arxiv-2412-13139.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Isabella L. Giovannelli, Steven M. Anlage. The scattering matrix S S linearly relates the vector of incoming waves to outgoing wave excitations, and contains an enormous amount of information about the scattering system and its connections to the scattering channels. Time delay is one way to extract information from S S , and the transmission time delay τ T \tau_{T} is a complex (even for Hermitian systems with unitary scattering matrices) measure of how long a wave excitation lingers before being transmitted.

Unleashing Generative Attention for Dynamic Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 27–31, 2025; Dublin, Ireland Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’25), October 27
arxiv-2508-02050.creator: Yuli Liu, Wenjun Kong, Cheng Luo, Weizhi Ma
arxiv-2508-02050.description: Abstract . Sequential Recommendation (SR) focuses on personalizing user experiences by predicting future preferences based on historical interactions. Transformer models, with their attention mechanisms, have become the dominant architecture in SR tasks due to their ability to capture dependencies in user behavior sequences. However, traditional attention mechanisms, where attention weights are computed through query-key transformations, are inherently linear and deterministic.

arxiv-2510-11291.title: Network-Optimised Spiking Neural Network (NOS) Scheduling for 6G O-RAN: Spectral Margin and Delay-Tail Control
arxiv-2510-11291.creator: 1 st Muhammad Bilal, 2 nd Xiaolong Xu
arxiv-2510-11291.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Muhammad Bilal, 2 nd Xiaolong Xu. This work presents Network-Optimised Spiking Neural (NOS) based delay-aware scheduler for 6G radio access. The proposed scheme couples a bounded two-state kernel to a clique-feasible, proportional-fair (PF) grant head, where the excitability state serves as a finite-buffer proxy and a recovery state acts as a supresser for repeated grants, while neighbour pressure is injected along the interference graph through delayed spikes.

pmc-10619039.description: BackgroundPeople with severe mental illness (SMI) have a higher prevalence of several chronic physical health conditions, and the prevalence of physical multimorbidity is expected to rise. The aim of this study was to assess the strength of the association between SMI and physical multimorbidity.

pmc-10768388.title: COVID-19 frequency and clinical course in children with asthma
pmc-10768388.creator: Muhammet Cihat Özata, Ümmügülsüm Dikici, Öner Özdemir
pmc-10768388.description: BACKGROUNDThe epidemic of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 infection, known as the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), has caused a global health concern. Since its emergence, numerous studies have focused on various clinical manifestations and outcomes in different populations. However, studies are ongoing as the consequences and impact of COVID-19 in children with chronic diseases such as asthma are controversial.

pmc-11394694.creator: Marek Kos, Krzysztof Bojarski, Paulina Mertowska, Sebastian Mertowski, Piotr Tomaka, Łukasz Dziki, Ewelina Grywalska
pmc-11394694.description: Introduction: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) play a vital role in the innate immune response, recognizing pathogens and initiating the inflammatory response. Research suggests that TLRs may also have a significant impact on the development and progression of cancers, including gastric cancer (GC).

pmc-12457828.title: Novel platelet-rich plasma/ hyaluronic acid lyophilized formulations for wound healing applications
pmc-12457828.creator: Antonella D’Agostino, Maria d’Agostino, Marta Nardini, Anita Muraglia, Celeste Di Meo, Maddalena Mastrogiacomo, Chiara Schiraldi
pmc-12457828.description: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) is a well-known biological product used in regenerative medicine. One of the limitations of its clinical use is the need for surgeons to obtain ready-to-use preparations. A lyophilized formulation with specific and reproducible levels of growth factors can, therefore, be considered a significant improvement for tissue regeneration.

pmc-13053595.title: Acceptability of screening for celiac disease at Youth Health Care Centers in The Netherlands
pmc-13053595.creator: Willemien de Vries, Nan van Geloven, M Luisa Mearin, Lucy Smit, Martine C de Vries, Caroline R Meijer-Boekel
pmc-13053595.description: A novel evaluation of the acceptability of screening and mass screening for celiac disease (CD) in young children at the Preventive Youth Health Care Centres (YHCCs) in the Netherlands. Children aged 1–4 years attending the YHCC Kennemerland region were screened for CD-related symptoms. Symptomatic children were offered a point-of-care (POC) test for CD antibodies.

pmc-13380639.title: Prevalence of Post-Traumatic Stress Injuries Among Canadian Public Safety Communicators: A Nationwide Comparative Study: Prévalence des blessures de stress post-traumatique chez les communicateurs en sécurité publique canadiens : étude comparative nationale
pmc-13380639.creator: Steve Geoffrion, Constance Boulé, Filippo Rapisarda, Stephen Czarnuch, Rosemary Ricciardelli
pmc-13380639.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPublic safety communicators (PSCs, 911 call-takers, dispatchers, and others) play a critical role in Canada's emergency response system, yet they remain largely understudied compared with other public safety professionals (PSP). Although PSCs do not intervene directly at emergency scenes, they are routinely exposed to potentially psychologically traumatic events and high operational stress during calls, placing them at elevated risk for post-traumatic stress injuries (PTSIs).

pmc-13390043.title: Synthesis and Reactivity of Boron Triflate and Bistriflimide Complexes Bearing Two ortho-Carboranes
pmc-13390043.creator: Kanika Vashisth, Ragene A. Thornton, Caleb D. Martin
pmc-13390043.description: This work discloses the synthesis of boron complexes featuring two 1-methyl-ortho-carborane substituents (Me oCb) and a weakly coordinating pseudohalide, trifluoromethanesulfonate (OTf) or bistriflimide (NTf2). Assessing their Lewis acidity experimentally by NMR probes, OPEt3 and 4-fluorobenzonitrile, revealed they are highly electrophilic, and DFT computations place their fluoride affinity in the Lewis super acidic regime.

pmc-13425169.title: Work productivity in Behçet syndrome
pmc-13425169.creator: Nergis Serin, Yesim Ozguler, Sinem Nihal Esatoglu, Vedat Hamuryudan, Gulen Hatemi
pmc-13425169.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesBehçet syndrome (BS) is a multisystem vasculitis that is most active during young adulthood. We aimed to evaluate work productivity and stability in patients with BS and compare it with diseased and healthy controls (HCs) in a cross-sectional study.MethodsWe evaluated 125 consecutive patients with BS for work productivity and stability using the Work Productivity and Activity Impairment Questionnaire (WPAI), Work Productivity Survey (WPS), and Work Instability Scale (WIS).

pmc-13432976.title: Maternal propranolol as a safe alternative to invasive fetal surgery in chorioangioma management
pmc-13432976.creator: L E van der Meeren, F Slaghekke, S Zaaijer, F Prein, E Lopriore, M C Haak
pmc-13432976.description: Chorioangiomas are associated with a significant risk of fetal demise due to high‐output cardiac failure. Standard invasive treatment, including fetoscopic laser photocoagulation and intratumoral embolization, shows limited success and has high fetal mortality rates. The biological parallels between chorioangiomas and infantile hemangiomas suggest that these tumors may share common therapeutic targets.

pmc-13478596.title: CircRNAs derived from the tyrosine phosphatase PTPN22 impact chemosensitivity in ALK-positive T-cell lymphomas
pmc-13478596.creator: Elissa Andraos, Steffen Fuchs, Chloé Bessière, Lola Colras, Sandra Dailhau, Marina Bousquet, Aurore Touzart, Ludovic Lhermitte, Christine Gaspin, Stéphane Pyronnet, Laurence Lamant, Fabienne Meggetto, Loelia Babin
pmc-13478596.description: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL) is a subtype of T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL), classified into ALK(+) and ALK(–) subtypes, based on translocations of the ALK gene. ALK(+) ALCL have a favorable prognosis with polychemotherapy, yet some patients develop early chemoresistance, leading to treatment failure. The molecular mechanisms underlying this resistance remain poorly defined.

pmc-13573716.title: Clearance of p16‐positive cardiac cells improves age‐related cardiac remodeling in mice
pmc-13573716.creator: Mozhdeh Mehdizadeh, Martin Mackasey, Kimia Gharagozloo, Martin Aguilar, Patrice Naud, Allan Ochs, Nhung Vuong‐Robillard, Eric Thorin, Gerardo Ferbeyre, Jean‐Claude Tardif, Martin G. Sirois, Jean Francois Tanguay, Stanley Nattel
pmc-13573716.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Senescent cells are characterized by expression of markers like p16 and secretion of profibrotic and proinflammatory factors. The role of cellular senescence in age‐related cardiac remodeling and dysfunction is incompletely understood. This study aimed to: (i) evaluate the effect of p16‐ positive cell clearance on cardiac function and structure in aging mice, and (ii) assess the role of different cardiac cell‐types in the response. Hypertrophy markers, ion channels and calcium handling protein gene expression.

uslaw-usc-t22-s2805.title: 22 U.S.C. § 2805 — Withdrawal of Federal recognition or participation
uslaw-usc-t22-s2805.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s2805.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 40 (International Expositions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The President may withdraw Federal recognition or participation whenever he finds that continuing recognition or participation would be inconsistent with the national interest and with the purposes of this chapter.
